task_events.reference: You see lightning before hearing thunder because light travels much faster than sound. Both come from the same lightning event.
A fridge uses a vapor-compression refrigerant cycle to move heat from inside to outside. The refrigerant evaporates to absorb heat inside, then is compressed and condenses to release heat outside.
Bread goes stale faster in the fridge mainly because refrigeration speeds up starch retrogradation. Starch molecules reorganize and firm the crumb. It is not simply drying out.
Active noise-cancelling headphones use microphones to measure surrounding noise and produce an opposing sound wave that reduces it through destructive interference.
